notes: Unstressed receiver OMA sensitivity stated in mW only: 0.039 mW at 14.025 and 8.5 Gb/s; 0.029 mW at 4.25 Gb/s (PRBS patterns per footnotes). Transmitter and Dispersion Penalty (TDP) max 4.4 dB at 14.025 Gb/s and 3.2 dB at 8.5 Gb/s; not structured as penalty points with paired penalized OSNR/sensitivity values. 25 km link length based on 15 dB link budget. Optical Modulation Amplitude (OMA) transmitter min 1260 µW(dBm) per FC equivalent ER spec. Spectral Width (RMS) max 1 nm at 28.05 Gb/s notation in table. Supply current typ 200 mA max 300 mA; module power consumption never exceeds 1 W with established link. Case operating temperature 0 to 70 °C; storage -40 to 85 °C.
